concerns.text: Tasks T045 and T046 implement a 'Real Data First' policy that forces pipeline exit on fetch failure. This contradicts Spec FR-006, US-1 (Scenario 3), and Plan 'Critical Scientific Reframing' which mandate an automatic pivot to narrative synthesis (N < 10) as a valid outcome, not a failure state. No task exists to implement the required graceful fallback logic for missing real data.

Task T009b (Real Data Validator) is marked as incomplete/broken in the Analyze report. It is the critical gate for detecting study count (N) and triggering the narrative fallback required by FR-006 and SC-005. Without a functional T009b, the system cannot satisfy the requirement to switch modes when N < 10.

Task T014 (Meta-Analysis) is marked as incomplete/broken. It is required to implement the random-effects model (FR-001), I² calculation (FR-002), Egger's test (FR-003), and Bonferroni correction (FR-005). The Analyze report notes missing `study_count.json` dependency logic, preventing the execution of these core functional requirements.

Tasks T047 (Power Analysis) and T048 (Report Integration) are present but not tagged to any User Story or FR/SC. While the Spec mentions 'Systematic Review of Absence', there is no explicit FR or SC requiring a formal Power Analysis (MDES) calculation. These tasks appear to be scope creep or unlinked plan elements.

Task T021 implements Holm-Bonferroni correction. Spec FR-005 explicitly mandates 'Bonferroni correction'. While Holm is statistically sound, the task implements an algorithm not explicitly authorized in the requirements, creating a potential traceability gap between the spec and the implementation.
